summary: Iteration 3 (Feature Pack 2) verified end-to-end. Backend: existing 17/17 pytest still 100% pass (no backend changes). Frontend on 390px viewport: (1a) Explore search+filter — 3 trending workouts render (office/abs/cardio), 'abs' search leaves only Abs Intermediate, no-match shows explore-trending-empty, category chips Cardio/Abs/All filter correctly, topic Nutrition navigates to /nutrition; (1b) Podcast search+filter — Sleep chip shows exactly 2 tracks (Twilight Zone, Meditation Lullaby), Mindset chip shows only Living Beyond Fear, New shows all 4, search 'fear' narrows to Living Beyond Fear, no-match shows podcast-empty-state, meditation topic still navigates to /wellness/podcast; (2) AchievementsModal opens from profile-achievements-button, all 5 badges present with dynamic statuses (10k-club=Unlocked, hydration-hero=In Progress, mindful-master=Unlocked, 7-day-streak=Unlocked, macro-balancer=Locked); (3) Dashboard WeeklyRecapBanner renders correct copy under Health Score and dismisses immediately on X click; (4) Router v7 future flag warnings — 0 occurrences in console (confirmed clean). No console errors on any screen.

issues: On 390px mobile viewport the bottom-sheet appears anchored under the bottom navigation bar so the 5-badge grid is visually clipped/overlapped by the fixed bottom nav (LOGOUT button and bottom tab bar overlay the sheet). Sheet still opens and DOM contains all badges — this is a z-index / bottom-inset layout issue in BottomSheet, not a data bug. Minor priority; user must scroll inside sheet to see badges.

action_items: (Design) Increase AchievementsModal bottom-sheet z-index above the fixed bottom nav, or add bottom padding equal to nav height so the badge grid isn't visually clipped on mobile viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: AchievementsModal cleanly derives dynamic statuses from useDashboardMetrics + useActivityTrends — good separation.
CATEGORY_MATCHERS map in MindfulnessPodcast is a nice pattern; New/Now/Popular/Trending all return true which correctly matches the spec.
WeeklyRecapBanner uses local state only (no persistence) — matches spec; reappears on reload as expected.
main.tsx BrowserRouter future flags are correctly set — warnings now suppressed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature Pack 2 fully verified on 390px viewport. Data-testids confirmed live: explore-search-input, explore-category-{all,cardio,office,abs}, explore-trending-{office-workout,abs-intermediate,cardio-blast}, explore-trending-empty, podcast-search-input, podcast-category-{new,now,popular,trending,mindset,sleep}, podcast-empty-state, dashboard-weekly-recap-banner, dashboard-weekly-recap-dismiss, profile-achievements-button, achievements-modal, achievement-badge-<id>, achievement-status-<id>. Router future-flag warnings: 0. Only outstanding item is a minor design issue where AchievementsModal bottom-sheet is visually overlapped by the fixed bottom navigation bar on mobile viewports.
